```{r libraries, results = "hide"}
library(dplyr) # Tidy data
library(tidyverse) # Tidy data
library(roahd) # Functional data analysis
library(fda) # Functional data analysis
library(conformalInference.fd) # Conformal prediction (functional)
library(vars) # VAR

library(viridis) # Color palette
```

```{r dataset}
data = read.csv("../dataset/dataset_clorofilla_filtrata_3anni.csv")

# Round coordinates to 3 decimal places to match with the distance dataset
data$Lon = round(data$Lon, 3)
data$Lat = round(data$Lat, 3)

# Dataset of the distances
ordered_distances = read.csv("../dataset/bordo_con_distanze.csv")
data_pos = data %>%
  inner_join(ordered_distances, by = c("Lat", "Lon"))

# Final dataset
chl_pos = data_pos %>%
  dplyr::select(Date, Lat, Lon, Chl, distanza_cumulata)

chl_pos$Date = as.Date(chl_pos$Date)

# Space grid
x = sort(unique(chl_pos$distanza_cumulata))

# Parameters
n_days = length(unique(chl_pos$Date))
```

```{r data exploration}
dim(data_pos)
summary(data_pos)

table(data_pos$Pos_ID)
```


```{r data matrix setup}
data_matrix_df = chl_pos %>%
  dplyr::select(Date, distanza_cumulata, Chl) %>%
  arrange(Date, distanza_cumulata) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = distanza_cumulata, values_from = Chl)

data_matrix = as.matrix(data_matrix_df[,-1])

sum(is.na(data.matrix))

dim(data_matrix)
```

```{r functional data setup}
colours = viridis(n_days)

# Define B-spline Basis
basis = create.bspline.basis(
  rangeval = range(x), 
  breaks = x,           # Placing knots at real data points
  norder = 4            # Cubic splines
)

# Convert discrete data to functional objects
chl_fd <- Data2fd(argvals = x, y = t(data_matrix), basisobj = basis)

# Comparison between Raw Data and FDA Smoothing
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
matplot(x, t(data_matrix), type = "l", lty = 1, lwd = 1, col = colours,
        xlab = "Distance", ylab = "Chl", main = "Original Data (Raw)")
plot(chl_fd, col = colours, lty = 1, lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Distance", ylab = "Chl", main = "FDA Smooth (B-splines)")
# Highlight knots on the plot
knots = c(basis$rangeval[1], basis$params, basis$rangeval[2])
abline(v = knots, col = "gray90", lty = 3)
rug(knots, col = "red", lwd = 1.5)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r prediction setup, echo=TRUE}
n_comp = 4
chl_pca = pca.fd(chl_fd, nharm = n_comp)

scores_data = chl_pca$scores

n_tot <- nrow(scores_data)
n_val <- 7  # Validation horizon (1 week)

# Split into Training and Validation sets
train_set <- scores_data[1:(n_tot - n_val), ]
val_set   <- scores_data[(n_tot - n_val + 1):n_tot, ]

# Define ground truth curves for error calculation
curve_reali <- chl_fd[(n_tot - n_val + 1):n_tot]

# Function to calculate functional RMSE day by day
compute.daily.rmse <- function(curve_reali, curve_predette) {
  diff_fd <- curve_reali - curve_predette
  integrali_quadrati <- diag(inprod(diff_fd, diff_fd))
  return(sqrt(integrali_quadrati))
}
```

```{r VAR prediction, echo=TRUE}
fit_var_train <- VAR(train_set, p = 7, type = "both")
pred_var_obj <- predict(fit_var_train, n.ahead = n_val)

# Extract predicted scores
scores_var <- sapply(pred_var_obj$fcst, function(x) x[, "fcst"])
if(nrow(scores_var) != n_val) scores_var <- t(scores_var)

# Reconstruct functional profiles
coef_pred_var <- chl_pca$harmonics$coefs[, 1:4] %*% t(scores_var)
curve_var_fd <- fd(coef_pred_var + as.vector(chl_pca$meanfd$coefs), basis)

err_var <- compute.daily.rmse(curve_reali, curve_var_fd)
```

```{r prediction plot, echo=TRUE}
#par(mfrow = c(4, 2))
for (i in 1:n_val) {
  plot(chl_fd[n_tot - n_val + i], col = "black", lwd = 2, ylim = c(0, 5),
       main = paste("VECM Validation: Day", i))
  plot(curve_var_fd[i], col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2, add = TRUE)
}
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

plot(curve_var_fd)
```

```{r conformal prediction, echo=TRUE}
curve_reali <- chl_fd[(n_tot - n_val + 1):n_tot]

# 1. Setup Parameters
alpha <- 0.05
n_cal <- n_val  # Using the 7-day validation set as calibration

# 2. Evaluate curves on a fine grid for comparison
grid_x <- seq(min(x), max(x), length.out = 200)
eval_reali <- eval.fd(grid_x, curve_reali)      # True curves (Validation)
eval_pred  <- eval.fd(grid_x, curve_var_fd)     # Predicted curves (VAR)

# 3. Calculate Non-conformity Scores (Max Absolute Deviation)
# We calculate the max difference across the grid for each of the 7 days
res_matrix <- abs(eval_reali - eval_pred)
scores <- apply(res_matrix, 2, max) 

# 4. Calculate the Conformal Quantile (k_alpha)
# This is the "radius" of our prediction band
prob_val <- min((1 - alpha) * (1 + 1/n_cal), 1)
k_alpha <- quantile(scores, probs = prob_val, type = 1)

# 5. Construct Bands for a specific day (e.g., Day 1 of the forecast)
day_to_plot <- 1
pred_vals <- eval_pred[, day_to_plot]
lower_band <- pred_vals - k_alpha
upper_band <- pred_vals + k_alpha

# 6. Visualization
plot(grid_x, pred_vals, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "blue", 
     ylim = c(min(lower_band) - 0.5, max(upper_band) + 0.5),
     xlab = "Distance", ylab = "Chl",
     main = paste("VAR Forecast Day", day_to_plot, "with 95% Conformal Band"))

# Add the uncertainty band
polygon(c(grid_x, rev(grid_x)), c(upper_band, rev(lower_band)), 
        col = rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.2), border = NA)

# Add the predicted line and the true observed line for comparison
lines(grid_x, pred_vals, col = "blue", lwd = 2)
lines(grid_x, eval_reali[, day_to_plot], col = "black", lty = 2)
legend("topright", legend=c("Predicted", "Actual", "95% Band"), 
       col=c("blue", "black", "red"), lty=c(1, 2, 1), pch=c(NA, NA, 15))


```

```{r adaptive conformal prediction, echo=TRUE}
# 1. ACI Parameters
gamma <- 0.05       # Learning rate (step size for adaptation)
alpha_target <- 0.05 # Target error rate (95% coverage)
alpha_t <- alpha_target # Initial alpha

# We need a set of initial "calibration" scores to pick a starting k_alpha
# Let's use the first day of validation or a small historical buffer
initial_scores <- scores # From your previous static calculation

# 2. Containers for results
aci_upper <- matrix(0, nrow = length(grid_x), ncol = n_val)
aci_lower <- matrix(0, nrow = length(grid_x), ncol = n_val)
k_values <- numeric(n_val)

# 3. Sequential Update Loop
for (t in 1:n_val) {
  # A. Calculate k_alpha based on current alpha_t
  # Ensure alpha_t stays in a valid range (0, 1)
  prob_val <- 1 - max(0, min(alpha_t, 1))
  k_t <- quantile(initial_scores, probs = prob_val, type = 1)
  k_values[t] <- k_t
  
  # B. Construct Band for Day t
  pred_t <- eval_pred[, t]
  aci_upper[, t] <- pred_t + k_t
  aci_lower[, t] <- pred_t - k_t
  
  # C. Check Coverage (Did the real curve stay inside the band?)
  real_t <- eval_reali[, t]
  # We check if the MAX error of the day exceeded our threshold k_t
  error_occured <- if (max(abs(real_t - pred_t)) > k_t) 1 else 0
  
  # D. Update alpha_t for the NEXT day (The "Adaptive" step)
  alpha_t <- alpha_t + gamma * (alpha_target - error_occured)
}

for(t in 1:n_val){
  plot(grid_x, eval_pred[, t], type = "l", col = "blue", lwd = 2,
     ylim = range(c(aci_lower[, t], aci_upper[, t])),
     main = paste("ACI Forecast: Day", t),
     xlab = "Distance", ylab = "Chl")

  polygon(c(grid_x, rev(grid_x)), 
          c(aci_upper[, t], rev(aci_lower[, t])), 
          col = rgb(0, 1, 0, 0.2), border = NA)

  lines(grid_x, eval_reali[, t], col = "black", lty = 2)
  legend("topright", legend=c("Predicted", "Actual", "ACI Band"), 
        col=c("blue", "black", "green"), lty=c(1, 2, 1), pch=c(NA, NA, 15))
}
```
